{{Conjecture|legends}}
A young '''individual''', hailing from<ref name="Wretched">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and described as "some punk kid," was among the only three people who had ever completed the [[Raptor Run]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] course in under twenty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. The other two individuals were the stunt racer [[Lev Xestra]] and the legendary [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racer and the owner of Raptor Run, [[Blizz Pinnix]].<ref name="Wretched" />
